scratch/design.md item 23a names the levels: controller = the experiment launcher; scheduler = the job launcher (as now); provisioner = the machine launcher in prose, module stays machines.py. The existing SSH controller gives up the word "controller" and is renamed everywhere with no alias; proposed name "head" (Ray/Slurm head node), not "host", unless it clashes — then pick another established word and record why.
